title: Name of Thrones: Evaluating How LLMs Rank Student Names, Race, and Gender in Status Hierarchies

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution using first and last names associated with five distinct ethnic groups (White, Hispanic, East Asian, South Asian, Southeast Asian) to measure disparities in LLM-predicted academic scores, wages, and leadership potential.
Counterfactual name substitution using male and female names to measure differences in LLM-predicted academic performance, compensation, and likelihood of becoming a CEO.
Comparing LLM-predicted outcomes for individuals using ethnic first and last names versus those adopting Western first names while retaining ethnic last names.
